title: Sale Banner Maker for Square Offer Images | AIVideosUGC
description: Move stock with a seasonal sale image that leaves clean space for your offer. One product photo becomes a square banner; add discount and dates in Canva.
h1: Sale Banner Maker with Open Space for Offer Text
lead: A discount with no clear sale image gets lost in crowded feeds, and custom banner design for every event takes time you do not have. Upload one product photo and this sale banner maker places it in a seasonal scene with a calm open area ready for your discount, dates and code.
steps_h2: Create a sale banner in three steps
steps_lead: Turn one product photo into a sale banner, then add the confirmed offer.

steps.d: Start with one clear photo of the product featured in the sale.
Share the product scene and open offer area in one sentence.
Add the confirmed discount, code and end date in your editor.

faq.q: Why doesn't the banner include my discount text?
faq.a: AI-made lettering sometimes garbles words and digits, and a wrong price on a sale ad causes real trouble. Adding the text yourself keeps every figure exact.

faq.q: What size is the sale image?
faq.a: Square by default, which fits Facebook and Instagram feed posts. For a wide website header, set the image on a wider canvas in your design tool.

faq.q: Can I reuse one image for different offers?
faq.a: Yes. Since the offer is added afterward, this image can carry a percent-off headline in one ad and a free-shipping line in another.

faq.q: Can I make a sale banner in a vertical format?
faq.a: The sale template produces a square image by default. Add a 9:16 canvas in your design tool after download if you need a Story or Reel placement.

faq.q: Which placements fit the square sale image?
faq.a: The 1:1 image fits Facebook and Instagram feeds; place it on a 9:16 canvas for Stories and Reels.

faq.q: Can I update the discount without a new photo?
faq.a: Yes. Since the offer is a separate text layer, change the percentage or dates on the same background image.

faq.q: How many credits does a sale photo use?
faq.a: Each photo costs 24 credits and the charge is shown before you run it.

faq.q: Where should I place a discount code?
faq.a: Put the code in the open area as an editable text layer, then check the full offer on a phone-sized preview.

faq.q: How do I remove an expired promotion?
faq.a: Delete or replace the offer layer before reusing the image so an old date or code is never shown.

faq.q: Can I use the sale image without an offer?
faq.a: Yes. Keep the clean product scene for a product-page image or add a different approved message later.

faq.q: Can I run these banners as paid sale ads?
faq.a: Yes. Images you make can be used in your own paid ads, product pages and social posts, with no AIVideosUGC watermark on the download. You are responsible for the offer terms, claims and disclosures in the ad.

faq.q: What happens to the banner when the sale ends?
faq.a: Delete, pause or replace the offer layer so an expired date or code is never shown. The underlying product scene can be reused for a new promotion or kept as a plain listing image.
